messages:
maya: Heads-up: PM asked for a concise onboarding gate + ops flow for model catalog entries. Need a concrete template we can use for any new model (open or fine-tuned). Can we sketch requirements here?

sam_k: I'll start: minimal gates should be perf, cost delta, and behavioral parity on core prompt sets.

diego: Perf specifics: publish P50/P95 token latency on our 8k standard across 3 runs. Target: P95 <= 220ms for general families; flag model if > 350ms. Also include peak memory and KV cache footprint.

anjali: Cost metric: offline cost estimator that ingests sampled traces and outputs marginal cost per call vs baseline. Should include quant/precision scenarios and batchability score.

maya: Customer-facing gating: classify models as self-serve (GA) or enterprise-only. Enterprise can request pin windows and longer grace periods.

sam_k: Proposed gating checklist (draft):
- Benchmark: 3-run P95 latency below threshold for model family
- Quality: eval pass rate >= 95% on curated prompt suite OR delta <= 1.5% vs baseline
- Cost: marginal token cost <= +25% vs baseline OR have sidecar recommendation (e.g., quantized variant)
- Observability: canary config and rollback triggers attached

maya: Add rollout canary plan: 1% for 24h, 5% for 48h, 25% for 72h. Automated rollback on thresholds.

diego: Rollback conditions suggestion: P95 latency increase > 30% OR error rate > 0.5% OR quality drop > 2% absolute.

anjali: Compat shim requirement: if embedding schema or API shape changes, onboard must include a mapping doc + small adapter that transforms legacy requests. E.g., normalized vs unnormalized vectors, or dim reorder.

maya: Also add a "pin escape" flow: allow dual-serve routing (old + new) for 30 days while we run customer-specific fixes. Ops can grant extensions with justification.

product-ops: Ops note: pins consume capacity. Label pins as "soft" (reclaimable after grace) or "hard" (requires manual ops). Autoscaler respects both. We'll add tags to model metadata.

catalog-bot: Reminder: onboarding ticket must include raw bench logs, 3-run summaries, cost sidecar report, canary JSON, and compat docs if applicable. Missing artifacts block review.

sam_k: Example canary JSON to attach: ```json
{"canary_steps":[{"pct":1,"duration":"24h"},{"pct":5,"duration":"48h"},{"pct":25,"duration":"72h"}],"rollback_conditions":{"p95_latency_pct_increase":30,"error_rate_pct":0.5,"quality_drop_abs":2}}
```

anjali: Metadata additions to model spec: quant_tolerant=true/false, recommended_variants=["quant8","shorter_ctx"], pin_policy={"soft_days":30}.

maya: For pricing sidecar: runs offline on sampled traces, emits per-call uplift and recommended cheaper variant when uplift > 20%. Also include expected tail-cost (95th percentile cost) for budget planning.

diego: Note: some architectures lose quality when quantized. We need a small test harness that runs evaluation on quantized variants to measure semantic delta; flag if >1.5% drop.

product-ops: We'll draft the ops playbook for the pin escape hatch (how to request extensions, metrics to monitor, capacity tags). Will share a PR.

maya: Timeline: i'll convert this thread into an onboarding template by EOD tomorrow, engineering review by Friday. objections?

sam_k: No objections. i'll start on bench harness changes and metadata fields.

anjali: i'll build the cost sidecar prototype and the adapter template for compat shims.

maya: Thanks. i'll post the draft template linked here and reference required artifacts. :rocket:
